<!-- theorem-1: body_md -->
\label{thm:exist}
The existence spectrum of pentagonal geometries $\operatorname{PENT}(3,r)$ is $r \equiv 0$ or $1 \pmod 3$ except $r=4$ or $6$.
<!-- end theorem-1 -->
<!-- theorem-2: body_md -->
\label{thm:cycexist}
The existence spectrum of cyclic pentagonal geometries $\operatorname{PENT}(3,r)$ is $r \equiv 1$ or $10 \pmod {12}$.
<!-- end theorem-2 -->
<!-- theorem-3: body_md -->
\label{thm:revexist}
The existence spectrum of reverse pentagonal geometries $\operatorname{PENT}(3,r)$ is $r \equiv 1$ or $10 \pmod {12}$.
<!-- end theorem-3 -->
